about: Bright Smile Dental is a family and cosmetic dental practice with two locations in Montgomery County, Maryland. The Bethesda office is the flagship location and is open on Saturdays for patients who can't make it in during the week. The Rockville office serves the north county area on weekdays. New patients are welcome at both locations.

new_patient_process: Book by phone at (301) 555-0148 or request an appointment through the website or chatbot.
Share your name, phone, email, reason for visit, and preferred location. The front desk calls you within one business day to schedule.
Bring a photo ID, your insurance card, and a list of current medications to your first visit.
Arrive 15 minutes early to complete intake forms, or complete them online in advance.
emergencies: Dental emergencies during office hours: call (301) 555-0148 and the office will fit you in the same day when possible.
After hours: existing patients can call the same number for the on-call dentist.
Severe swelling, uncontrolled bleeding, or trauma should go to the nearest emergency room.
The assistant must not give medical or dental treatment advice. All symptom and medication questions go to the office.

known_issues.conflict: The About section says Saturdays 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM, but the hours table says Saturday 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM.
known_issues.handling: Say the Bethesda office is open Saturday mornings and ask the patient to call (301) 555-0148 to confirm exact Saturday hours. Never state either time range as fact.
